visual_review.material_identity: Irregular broad rounded-polygon cobbles with a small number of medium infill stones and restrained olive-earth joints.
visual_review.style: Low-contrast warm gray/taupe matte faces with broad quiet tonal facets; no outer square frame or center spotlight. Some soft irregular face shading remains, but original dense grit/chips are greatly reduced.
visual_review.stone_scale: Visual estimate approximately6-8 main cobbles across representative horizontal bands, plus infill; requested10-14 main stones was not fully achieved. Retained honestly as a candidate, not stretched or regenerated before parent review.
visual_review.candidate128_world_effect: Main stones approximately16-23logical units across by rough visual width estimates; parent should judge actual scene scale.
visual_review.coverage: Opaque edge-to-edge stones, no silhouette or margin; no natural seamlessness claim.
